card.name: Words right after a dose amount
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as each, every, for or if that come straight after a number with a unit (e.g. 240 mg every, 9.1 mg each). Also fires on a few word starts inside parentheses like intr in intravenous.

modes.label: Frequency word after dose
modes.description: The word every or each directly follows an amount in mg or mEq and introduces a schedule or per-unit amount.
modes.example: weighing 40 kg or more: 240 mg<< every>> 2 weeks or 480

modes.label: Other link after a figure
modes.description: Words like for or if follow a percentage or number in parentheses, introducing a group or condition.

card.plain: It marks the little word that comes right after a dose amount, like the every in 240 mg every 2 weeks.
